claims.statement: CI gating is three jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml: `check` runs `pnpm check:all` (vue-tsc/tsc type checks) plus `pnpm lint:all`; `test` runs `pnpm test:all` (Vitest unit tests only — Android emulator E2E never enters CI); `android-unit-test` runs the JVM/Robolectric gate `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` after `sync:credentials`.

Task caching is enabled only for `pnpm check:all` (via `--cache`); `pnpm test:all` is deliberately uncached because a cache hit on the test gate would mean the tests never actually executed, reproducing the fake-green condition ADR-0084 eliminated.

The active testing tiers are app-lynx Vitest unit/template/contract tests, android-host Vitest contract gates, android-host JVM/Robolectric `testDebugUnitTest`, manual Appium/WebdriverIO emulator E2E, and local Stryker mutation over @pictelio/ugoira and @pictelio/update-check; the agent-browser, Playwright, and Vitest browser-component suites were removed with the WebView client (ADR-0203).

packages/android-host/vitest.config.ts includes `tests/unit/**/*.test.ts` and `tests/android-e2e/unit/**/*.test.ts` as two separate globs (issue #818) and excludes `tests/android-e2e/specs/**`, with `passWithNoTests: false`, so the android-e2e contract-tool unit tests reach `pnpm test` → `test:all` → CI without pulling emulator specs in.

webviewRemovalInvariants.test.ts is the authoritative WebView-client-removal gate: 10 invariant groups (no packages/app, zero Capacitor dependency declarations, host assets present, persisted-format literals intact, no cross-read of the deleted dir, root commands point at the single client, facade wording converged, client-switch gone, Gradle generation present, pnpm call sites resolve) enforced by 19 counterfactual positive controls plus 2 scan-coverage assertions.

agentsMd.contract.test.ts gates AGENTS.md: a ≤30,720-byte volume hard gate, Fluent-spec verbatim assertions pointing at the archive file with an entry pointer in AGENTS.md, hard-constraint anchor survival, single-engine facade wording (LynxActivity present; MainActivity/registerPlugin/'双引擎' absent), OPENWIKI marker-pair survival, stale-phrase zeroing, and root command-table reachability against root package.json scripts.

e2eContractSuiteCollected.test.ts guards that the 8 tests/android-e2e/unit contract tests are both on disk and matched by the host vitest.config.ts include globs, because passWithNoTests:false detects 'nothing collected' but not 'one directory dropped' (issue #818).

app-lynx has two Vitest configs: the main config injects compile-time constants with `__HOME_BLEED_HEADER__: 'true'` and excludes `**/*.fallback.test.ts`, while vitest.fallback.config.ts sets `__HOME_BLEED_HEADER__: 'false'` and collects only `src/**/*.fallback.test.ts`; `pnpm test` runs both configs so the default and fallback home-top-bar paths are each CI-covered.

Android emulator E2E is a manual Appium/WebdriverIO suite (packages/android-host/tests/android-e2e/) whose setupAndroidE2e chains AVD start, Chromedriver provisioning, APK build/install, Appium server, and a WebdriverIO session; because Lynx 4.0.1 exposes no accessibility view/text nodes, interactions use adb taps/swipes and content is asserted via screenshot + pixel analysis.

transition-matrix.spec.ts is the @release-gate spec — a 3-row (R1–R3) list-surface × user-action × content-assertion matrix whose assertions must be region-scoped frame diffs (content comparison), not single-frame existence; it runs before release and on big-PR manual trigger, never in per-PR CI.

The release-gate outer gate is a three-state classifier (releaseGate.ts): rows with judged>0 judge normally; judged=0 with skipped>0 warn 'unverified'; judged=0 with skipped=0 fail red; partial coverage (judged<expected) warns, so content-shape-induced skips never become random release-gate reds while a rewritten `return` cannot silently pass.

StrykerJS mutation testing is a local, non-CI sensitivity gate over @pictelio/ugoira and @pictelio/update-check (`pnpm test:mutation`); its mutation score is a weak-assertion detector, never correctness evidence, complementing the oracle check.

AGENTS.md enforces six test hard constraints — IO dual-path coverage, real-sample contracts, no silent degradation, refactor invariance, E2E reachability, and oracle traceability — with docs/testing/conventions.md as the verbatim detailed version; the detailed doc numbers the oracle constraint #5 (= AGENTS #6) and adds a detail-only #6 (async-test determinism).

ADR-0097 adds an execution layer for oracle traceability: a repo-localized .agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md blocking on Oracle check and Test strength, the T0.5 format gate scripts/verify-agent-skills.mjs, and T0 mechanical gates passWithNoTests:false plus oxlint expect-expect:error.

ADR-0163 establishes three QA defense lines — the @release-gate transition matrix, the BookmarkButton.host-matrix.test.ts host-matrix contract test, and the PlatformCheck.vue platform-consistency self-check page — plus a code-review platform/host contract audit axis, demoting happy-dom from the Lynx-runtime oracle to a browser-semantics reference.

ADR-0084 removed the agent-browser E2E job from CI because it needed a real Pixiv network path plus PIXIV_REFRESH_TOKEN that GitHub runners cannot reproduce; PIXIV_REFRESH_TOKEN is loaded only from a local .env and never enters GitHub Secrets or CI logs, and Android emulator E2E is therefore a manual, non-CI tier.

After ADR-0203 the dual-engine differential suites were reshaped into single-engine behavior baselines under packages/app-lynx/tests/contract/ (shared restriction/URL-rewrite/OAuth/illust-badge truth tables), and truthTableFixtureIntegrity.test.ts now guards fixture coverage completeness and zero-framework-dependency instead of cross-engine byte equality.
